# Template:Anchor

<div class="mw-parser-output">

A small template to manually create an anchor link, see <a href="http://meta.wikimedia.org/wiki/Template:Anchor" class="external free" rel="nofollow">http://meta.wikimedia.org/wiki/Template:Anchor</a>

Usage:

    &#123;&#123;anchor|foo&#125;&#125;

Creates an invisible anchor which you can link to within the page as

    [[#foo]]

or externally by

    [[page_name#foo]]

</div>
